_about: Held-out gate-2 tickets, written and committed BEFORE the verdict relevance threshold was calibrated. Used once, to evaluate it. 'duplicate' tickets have an existing asset (gold_unit_id); 'control' tickets have none.

tasks.ticket: Every one of our plugins reimplements AWS session setup. Write a shared module that handles credentials, assume-role and region configuration for all of them.
Generate the configuration file for our pull-request review bot from CODEOWNERS, so each directory requires approval from its owners.
Add the ability to produce and consume Kafka messages from our k6 load-test scripts.
Write a function that detects the points in a latency series where its behaviour shifts.
Create a single Docker image with an OpenTelemetry backend for traces, logs and metrics so developers can test locally.
Write a routine that safely reads memory at an arbitrary address from inside a signal handler without crashing the process.
Write a function that checks whether a string is a palindrome, ignoring punctuation and case.
Add a helper that converts a list of dicts to a CSV string with a header row.
Write a function that counts the business days between two dates, skipping weekends.
Add a helper that masks all but the last four digits of a credit card number.
Write a function that generates a random, URL-safe password reset token.
Add a function that converts a hex colour such as #ff8800 into an RGB tuple.
Write a function that removes duplicates from a list while keeping the original order.
Add a helper that pluralises an English noun for labels in the UI.
